description.value: An ordinary steel blade etched with faint markings that allow it to cut low-grade curses or weak barriers. The knife counts as a 4th grade cursed tool. While within 5 ft of a barrier, you can spend half a minute to discreetly cut a 5 ft hole in a Basic Curtain or similarly weak barrier without alerting the one who placed it. You can use the knife in this way three times before it breaks and becomes unusable.
